message.content: {"answer": "C", "option_text": "Pulmonary sequestration", "reason": "The provided images are axial CT scans (not chest X-rays), showing a retrocardiac cystic lesion with an air-fluid level in the left lower lobe, compensatory hyperinflation of the adjacent lung, and a dilated azygos vein. This triad—specifically the systemic arterial supply implied by the vascular findings and the location—is characteristic of intralobar pulmonary sequestration. The other options do not typically present with this specific combination of a retrocardiac air-fluid level and associated vascular anomalies in a young patient."}
